theme.rationale: User requested white and light gray backgrounds. A light theme is essential for a data-dense ERP/POS used in bright retail or industrial laundry environments to reduce eye strain and maintain high visibility.

headings.rationale: Manrope gives a geometric, premium SaaS look without being overused like Inter.

body.rationale: Highly legible for dense data, tables, and financial numbers.

monospace.usage: Used exclusively for POS Ticket 80mm layout, financial IDs, order numbers, and tracking codes.

primary.usage: Main CTA buttons, active state indicators, primary data visualizations

grid_system.dashboard: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. All cards must be h-full.
grid_system.pos_split: Split layout on desktop: Left side (Services Catalog) takes col-span-8. Right side (Cart/Summary/Payment) takes col-span-4. Total 12 columns.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use padding generously inside cards (p-6) to prevent text collision. Use gap-4 for related items, gap-8 for distinct sections.

sidebar.style: Fixed on desktop, hidden on mobile (use hamburger menu). Deep navy background (#0F172A).
sidebar.items: Icon + Text. Inactive text is slate-400. Active item gets white text and a subtle left-border or background highlight using the primary color.
sidebar.bottom: User profile summary (Avatar, Name, Role) fixed at the bottom.

topbar.style: Sticky top, bg-white, 1px bottom border (border-slate-200). h-16.
topbar.contents: Global Search bar (left-aligned), Notification Bell (with red dot for unread), and a quick 'New Order' primary button.

cards.style: Flat solid backgrounds (bg-white). 1px border-slate-200. rounded-xl. NO heavy shadows, only subtle shadow-sm.
cards.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) and shadow-md for interactive cards only.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-semibold hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors flex items-center gap-2
buttons.outline: border border-slate-300 bg-transparent text-slate-700 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 flex items-center gap-2
buttons.icon_buttons: p-2 rounded-md hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors

status_badges.shape: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold border

pos_ticket_80mm.style: Strict width max-w-[300px] mx-auto bg-white text-black p-4 font-mono text-xs border border-slate-200 shadow-sm
pos_ticket_80mm.typography: JetBrains Mono or standard monospace. Use uppercase for headers.
pos_ticket_80mm.layout: Flexbox/Grid for aligning Item Name (Left) and Price (Right). Dashed borders for separators (border-dashed border-b border-black).
pos_ticket_80mm.actions: Must include a 'Print' button outside the ticket container.

tables.style: Modern clean tables. No vertical borders. Subdued horizontal borders (border-slate-100). Hover effect on rows (hover:bg-slate-50).
tables.headers: Uppercase, text-xs, font-semibold, text-slate-500, bg-slate-50/50 p-3.

motion_and_interactions.general: Keep animations snappy. This is an ERP, users value speed over flashy delays.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Use transition-colors duration-200 for all buttons and rows.
motion_and_interactions.modals: Fade in with a slight scale-up (0.95 to 1). backdrop-blur-sm on the overlay.
motion_and_interactions.toast: Slide in from bottom-right. Use 'sonner' library. Auto-dismiss after 3-5 seconds.

login_background.description: Clean folded white linen, used as a subtle, premium background for the login page.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a premium SaaS ERP. DO NOT make it look like a generic Bootstrap template.
Use Lucide React for all iconography.
Implement the fixed sidebar on desktop. Ensure main content has ml-64 (or equivalent) to not hide under the sidebar.
For the POS view, ensure the right-side cart is fixed/sticky so it remains visible while scrolling through the services catalog.
The 80mm ticket must be styled entirely with CSS and printable using window.print() targeting only the ticket area (or hiding everything else with print media queries).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='pos-checkout-btn').
Apply Shadcn/UI for modals, dropdowns, and toast (Sonner), but customize the borders and padding to match the clean, flat look specified above.
